<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShopPurchase" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-purchase">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopPurchase" name="Online Shop Purchase" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderStarted" name="Order started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_SplitStart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Split_Start" name="Start order activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_SplitStart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitStart_SelectItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitStart_SetPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitStart_SelectItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseReward_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPayment" name="Set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitStart_SetPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPayment_SplitPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Split_Payment" name="Payment option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPayment_SplitPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitPayment_Pay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitPayment_Installment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitPayment_Pay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_MergePayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteInstallment" name="Complete installment agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitPayment_Installment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Installment_MergePayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Payment" name="Payment completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_MergePayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Installment_MergePayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergePayment_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join_Order" name="Items, reward and payment ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseReward_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergePayment_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_MergeDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Delivery" name="Delivery needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_MergeDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnItems_MergeDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeDelivery_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeDelivery_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deliver_SplitReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Split_Return" name="Items returned for exchange?" default="Flow_NoReturn">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deliver_SplitReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnItems_MergeDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoReturn</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Login" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderStarted" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_SplitStart" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_Split_Start"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitStart_SelectItems" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Start" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitStart_SetPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Start" targetRef="Task_SetPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseReward_Join" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_Join_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPayment_SplitPayment" sourceRef="Task_SetPayment" targetRef="Gateway_Split_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitPayment_Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Payment" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitPayment_Installment" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Payment" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_MergePayment" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Installment_MergePayment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallment" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergePayment_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Payment" targetRef="Gateway_Join_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_MergeDelivery" sourceRef="Gateway_Join_Order" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeDelivery_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Delivery" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_SplitReturn" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_Split_Return"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReturn" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Return" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return" sourceRef="Gateway_Split_Return" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsReturned == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnItems_MergeDelivery" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Delivery"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
